verdict.rationale: ADK ships a built-in development Web UI explicitly for testing, evaluating, and debugging agents, and provides callbacks to hook into execution lifecycle events for logging/monitoring, which together imply some run-level visibility into tool and model calls. However, the evidence never explicitly describes a trace view showing each LLM call and tool invocation of a run, nor mentions integration with tracing standards (e.g., OpenTelemetry) or a dedicated observability dashboard beyond the dev/eval UI. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of per-call tracing UI, tool-invocation-level trace inspection, and any third-party/hands-on confirmation of this granularity.
